# Upstream workflow reference

These files were imported from SkyMP commit `756fb86b05ab5c2fae4f9bc3c6d52ca580b8bdd3` and preserved here for reference. GitHub only executes workflows directly under `.github/workflows`.

The upstream workflows include scheduled native builds, deployment, package publishing and integrations with upstream-specific secrets. This fork uses `lab-checks.yml` for client compilation and local-development checks. Enable or adapt native build workflows deliberately when the fork's build inputs are ready.
